purpose.en: Train the legs and hips with a controlled step-up.

text.zh: 整只脚踩稳椅面，用前腿发力站起
text.en: Plant your whole foot on the seat and stand up using the front leg

text.zh: 膝盖保持与脚尖同向，站起后再缓慢下降
text.en: Keep your knee aligned with your toes, then lower slowly.

text.zh: 使用稳固、防滑、适合自己高度的支撑物
text.en: Use a stable, non-slip support at a height you can control.

commonErrors.zh: 后脚猛蹬地面或借惯性冲起
commonErrors.en: Pushing hard with the trailing foot or using momentum.

commonErrors.zh: 椅子晃动或脚掌只踩在边缘
commonErrors.en: Using an unstable chair or placing only part of the foot on its edge.

cautions.zh: 膝：上、下步都保持膝盖与脚尖方向一致，避免失控内扣。
cautions.en: Knee: keep the knee tracking with the toes during both ascent and descent.

cautions.zh: 踝与平衡：整只脚踩稳支撑面，缓慢下步；只使用牢固、防滑且高度可控的台阶或凳面。
cautions.en: Ankle and balance: plant the whole foot, step down slowly, and use a stable non-slip platform of a manageable height.
